# Rajeev Freelancer

> Rajeev is a senior freelancer and AI / digital-marketing consultant with 12+ years of experience (ex-IOG, Accenture, Google). He builds websites and custom software, and runs SEO, digital marketing, GEO (AI-search optimization), AI automation, and WhatsApp/SMS marketing for founders and businesses in 27+ countries. Communication is fast, usually over WhatsApp, and every engagement is delivered personally — no account managers or offshore relays.

- [WhatsApp Marketing Freelancer](https://rajeevfreelancer.com/whatsapp-marketing-freelancer): Campaigns, auto-replies, chatbots and lead nurturing.
